prompt:
Please transform each uploaded photo into an individual high-end design poster. Use a 3:4 vertical composition, split strictly 1:1 into upper and lower sections. 

The upper half retains the original photo with slight color grading to give it an art magazine or exhibition feel. The lower half extracts the most recognizable subjects, outlines, and narrative relationships, reconstructing them into a hand-stitched textile collage illustration. 

The lower section must use large amounts of white space as its core composition language. The subject should be a small, refined focal point. Material textures should emphasize cotton/linen fibers, fabric grain, handmade stitches, and raw edges, creating a warm and restrained textile collage/appliqué feel. 

Extract 2–4 vibrant colors from the photo to represent the theme. Add minimal editorial text to create a sophisticated relationship between graphics and typography. Avoid copying every detail from the photo; instead, focus on selective refinement and handcrafted textures.
